descriptions.w3d_d31e_select_mode_801a92c8: Selects a rendering mode on an object: when the mode differs from +160, creates an instance of class record 0x80363b54 (mode 0) or 0x80363ba4 (otherwise) through 0x8020fcb4 and assigns it to the reference at +176 (add new, release old, store). Stores the mode and returns 0. Names are inferred.
